fightSong.title: Countdown
fightSong.lyrics: T-minus ten and we're ready to go / Columbus Astronauts stealing the show / Three, two, one, we ignite / Astronauts taking flight!

stadium.name: Launch Pad
stadium.tradition: The Countdown — entire stadium counts down from 10 pre-kickoff. If they hit zero in sync, the roof panels open (even though it's open-air). It's about vibes.

fanCulture.description: They wear NASA jackets. After big plays they yell 'Houston, we have a touchdown.' Very nerdy, very loud.
fanCulture.tailgate: Food trucks, craft beer, and arguing about space.

rivalries.name: The Steel Launch
rivalries.narrative: They forge steel, we launch past it.

paAnnouncer.touchdownCall: ASTRONAUT TOUCHDOWN! That's one small step!

cityFlavor: College town that grew up, space heritage, and midwest nice with an edge.
